dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: Let me think... The temperature of the hot spring should be pretty ideal right now. Fancy a dip?

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's about time to replace some old equipment...

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm talking about clothes and tools that can withstand very high temperatures. Our tribespeople need them to conduct regular inspections deep within the volcano.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: Koholasaurs are the only Saurians here that can traverse molten lava, so it falls on us to monitor the activities of the volcano.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: The volcano has always been known for accidents and mishaps, and remains a vulnerable spot for monster attacks. They could come in from both inside and out, so it's the least we can do to keep a close eye on it.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: The battle with the Abyss took its toll on us all. I've been resting and recouping for quite some time. In the meantime, a series of crises has depleted much of our equipment stores.

dialogues.speaker: Ahoeitu
dialogues.text: But it's not all bad. Equipment can be replaced. As long as the will to prevail stays strong, there's no crisis that can't be overcome.
